en.description: Write the WeChat article and make its pictures in one pass. Give a topic, what you are promoting, and who it is for — this WeChat Official Account article generator returns title candidates written for the feed, the digest line, a full article body structured for how people actually read on a phone, then renders the 2.35:1 cover and a set of in-body images that hold one look from top to bottom. Use it for WeChat Official Account posts, brand and product articles, promotional long-form, founder and expert columns, case studies, content marketing programmes, and any long-form post where the writing and the pictures have to be produced together rather than handed between two people.
en.summary: Give a topic and get title candidates, the digest line, a full article body written for phone reading, a 2.35:1 cover, and in-body images that answer specific paragraphs.
en.title: WeChat Article Visual Story: Write the Article and Make Its Pictures in One Pass
